text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The unusual behavior Orfevre displayed during the Tenno Sho (Spring) seemed to be only temporary, with no particular symptoms showing afterward—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We managed to set off for the Takarazuka Kinen without issue.
However, I can't let my guard down until
the final pre-race checks are complete.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Tedious.
I have already told you it is fine.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
So noisy from dawn till dusk...
Enough already, sit down.
choice_data_list: If anything happens, tell me right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as the bullet train began to move...
perhaps from sheer mental exhaustion, a wave of sleepiness washed over me—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Too slow.
React faster.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
……Fool.
Do not close your eyes before Me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Don't forget it.
Never forget that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, just to be safe, we had the medical staff
check things out, and the diagnosis came back
that there was no problem.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmph.
Your worries run far too deep.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"The common rabble as well...
Disrespectful though they were."
choice_data_list: ...Holding that press conference was the right move, wasn't it?
...I'm glad we held the press conference, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The voices of doubt cast toward Orfevre after her run in the Tenno Sho (Spring)... I could tell they thoroughly displeased her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So on the day before the race, in front of the press and officials—
they declared that there was absolutely nothing to worry about regarding Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So... in tomorrow's Takarazuka Kinen,
you will be running just as you always have?
choice_data_list: Yes, I can say that with certainty.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so powerful...!
Is that true,
Orfevre-san?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...It's just as
that thing said.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like you're really doing fine.
The fans are worried too...
I'll publish the article right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result, Orfevre commands overwhelming support today as well.
The sheer strength she has shown up to now is so rock-solid
that it cannot be easily shaken.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I just can't forget it, after all.
Lady Orfevre's kingly stride...!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan B
text_block_list.text: I want Orfevre to achieve a complete, decisive victory. Carrying our dreams with her—to the world!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This will likely be the final domestic race
before taking on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
To the fans, a powerful—
choice_data_list: Let's show them how amazing you are!
Let's show them how amazing you are!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Show it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"The people need only know one thing:
the might of a king whom none dare defy."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like this is going to be a boring race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right before the race. Just as I was about to send Orfevre off—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Looks like your body is doing better now.
...Phew, what a relief.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
There was... something I wanted to talk about today.
Um... well...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
I shall grant you an audience.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Those crimson eyes.
They get on my nerves.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Speak, without delay.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare look down on meee!
I am not... your subject!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I know you... don't really care about me at all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Still... I just...
I couldn't just brush it off.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I've always been watching your back.
Always... always... alwaaa... ays...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I still don't have confidence, you know.
But... I hate this even more!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—If I can't beat you...
It feels like I'll be stuck in the dark forever.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm declaring war for myself!
Today, I'm... gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Strongest in the country? Unrivaled? No! Your rival... is right here!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care about hope.
Dreams don't matter!
I won't let you... go to the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'!!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm dragging you down!
I'm going to be――the star!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Too little, too late...
—Win Variation.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You and I
have long since grown apart.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: If they had attacked alongside the recent rain, they might have borne fruit...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You think you can lay a hand on
my rock-solid throne after all this time?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I'll make it reach! 
Because... the race hasn't even started yet!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Hahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
—Pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Even a cornered rat can, at best,
only bite the cat.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Show your fangs to a lion,
and you'll see what happens... I shall trample you."
